records.title: Making Training-Free Diffusion Segmentors Scale with the Generative Power
records.reason: The work scales training-free diffusion segmentors for image segmentation; its target is visual discriminative performance, not LLM inference infrastructure.

records.reason: The paper proposes selection-valid diagnostics for multi-LLM routing and measures available routing gains, but the abstract does not establish latency, cost, or throughput optimization; efficiency relevance is plausible but unproven.

records.title: Making RALM Robust to Irrelevant Contexts via Layer Knowledge Guided Attention
records.reason: Layer-knowledge guided attention improves RALM robustness to irrelevant retrieved contexts; its relevance filtering could affect inference work, but the abstract reports answer quality rather than a measured efficiency effect.

records.title: What Happens When Small Is Made Smaller? Exploring the Impact of Compression on Small Data Pretrained Language Models
records.reason: This study examines compression effects on small-data pretrained language models; compression is directly relevant to model size and deployment, although the abstract frames its analysis around model quality rather than serving metrics.
records.abstract_evidence_excerpt: Compression techniques have been crucial in advancing machine learning by enabling efficient training and deployment of large-scale language models. records.title: Instruction Learning Paradigms: A Dual Perspective on White-Box and Black-Box LLMs
records.reason: The paper compares white-box and black-box instruction-learning paradigms for LLMs; the stated scope is instruction optimization and capability, not inference efficiency.
records.abstract_evidence_excerpt: Optimizing instructions for large language models (LLMs) is critical for harnessing their full potential in complex and diverse tasks.
